Chloe — wrote up answers below. Copying Laura for finance nuances. Long story short: AWS Private Offer is the recommended path for Innovatek's procurement timeline, with a few caveats to ensure co-sell credit is recognized quickly.

Executive summary (external-friendly):
- Recommend: Accept an AWS Private Offer if Innovatek needs procurement speed. We'll provide a private-offer SKU mapping and ensure the offer references the Redwood Marketplace listing and the associated Seller-of-Record (AWS Marketplace). To secure co-sell credit, Innovatek should include the Redwood deal ID (RDW-2027-INN-58) in the PO and forward the marketplace purchase confirmation to redwood-sales@redwood.ai within 5 business days of purchase.
- Alternative (direct Redwood invoice): If Innovatek requires Redwood to be seller-of-record (for VAT or custom T&Cs), Redwood can invoice directly. Co-sell credit is still attainable but requires a different reconciliation flow (salesforce/partner ops reconciliation at quarter close).

Detailed bullets for procurement (what we need to recognize co-sell credit when using AWS private offer):
- Private offer purchase confirmation (marketplace order id) emailed to redwood-sales@redwood.ai within 5 business days.
- A copy of the Purchaser PO that includes the Redwood deal id (RDW-2027-INN-58) as a reference field.
- Combined SKU mapping (we will provide a CSV) so finance can match line items. Use the exact SKU strings we provide in the private offer.
- If Innovatek requests seller-of-record changes after purchase, that can delay partner-crediting while we reconcile invoices across orgs.

Timing notes on co-sell credit recognition:
- Marketplace (AWS) purchases: Partner credit is typically recognized after marketplace settlement (AWS net 30-60 depending on their schedule) and after we reconcile marketplace order IDs to our bookings. Operationally expect partner ops to post credits in the same quarter if purchase is submitted within the first 40 days of the quarter; purchases late in quarter may roll to the next quarter.
- Direct Redwood invoice: Credits are processed via our partner reconciliation and depend on when invoice is paid and when the contract is executed; timing can be similar but tends to have one additional reconciliation step.

Seller-of-record implications:
- AWS as seller-of-record (Private Offer): Simplifies Innovatek procurement (private offers can be accepted quickly), but Redwood must rely on marketplace settlement reports for revenue recognition and partner crediting. VAT treatment is handled by AWS in many regions, which helps Innovatek.
- Redwood as seller-of-record: Better for custom contract terms and VAT handling in some markets, but may require Redwood finance to process international invoices and trigger a Redwood invoice-to-payment flow.

Next steps for you to send externally: short recommendation + attach SKU mapping and a 1-page co-sell checklist. I've attached the draft SKU mapping and a brief process note. Laura, please add anything finance-specific (VAT, PO acceptance window).

— Ben

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear questions. Short recommendation and next steps below.

Recommendation (short):
- If Innovatek needs to move fast and your procurement team prefers vendor billing via AWS, accept the AWS Private Offer. We will provide the exact SKU strings and a CSV mapping so your finance team can match line items. Please add the Redwood deal id (RDW-2027-INN-58) in your PO reference field and forward the marketplace purchase confirmation email to redwood-sales@redwood.ai within 5 business days of acceptance.
- If Innovatek requires Redwood to be seller-of-record for VAT or custom terms, we can execute our direct Redwood invoice path — expect slightly longer processing for vendor setup. Co-sell credit remains attainable in both scenarios but will follow different reconciliation flows.

What we will attach / send to you right after this:
- SKU mapping CSV for the private offer (named aws_private_offer_sku_mapping.csv)
- 1-page co-sell checklist (co-sell-credit-process-note.pdf) that lists required fields and where to forward confirmations
- A DocuSign private offer acceptance link if you confirm private offer route is OK

If you confirm private offer, we will:
1) Send the AWS private-offer link that contains the exact SKUs and pricing.
2) You accept in AWS Marketplace and forward the confirmation to redwood-sales@redwood.ai.
3) We validate the marketplace order id and reconcile on our side; partner crediting typically posts within the quarter if purchase is early in quarter.

Would you like us to generate the private offer now and share the link, or do you want Redwood invoice terms and a formal quote instead? Happy to hop on a 20-minute call today if that helps.
